show.description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.
